title: Fluxnova Workflow Config
description: Configuration for deploying, running, and evaluating a Fluxnova BPMN workflow.

fluxnova_url.description: Base URL of the Fluxnova engine REST API (e.g. http://localhost:8080/engine-rest).

bpmn_path.description: Path to the BPMN file — relative to the repo root, or absolute.

process_key.description: The 'id' attribute on <process> in the BPMN.

deployment_name.description: Human-readable deployment name shown in Cockpit.

subprocess_id.description: BPMN element ID of the ad-hoc subprocess that contains the LLM agent.

additional_bpmn_paths.description: Additional BPMN files to include in the SAME deployment (e.g. a called process referenced by a Call Activity). Paths are relative to the repo root, or absolute.

wait_for_activity.description: Optional BPMN activity ID (the element 'id' attribute). When set, the runner returns as soon as this activity completes instead of waiting for the whole process instance to finish — useful when downstream steps (eval service task, human review) shouldn't block the run. Omit to wait for the entire process. Overridden by the --wait-for-activity CLI flag.

variables.description: Initial process variables passed to the workflow instance.

mock_workers.description: Mock external-task workers. Keys are Camunda topic names; values are the output variables to complete each task with.

user_tasks.description: User task completions. Keys are task definition keys; values are variables to complete each task with.

dataset_path.description: Path to the golden dataset JSON file (relative to the repo root). Maintained by hand as a fixture.

available_tools.description: Tools available to the LLM agent. Keys are BPMN service-task element IDs; values are display names used in evaluation.

expected_tools.description: Ordered list of tool-expectation rules evaluated against the run's inputVariables at evaluation time. Rules use GitLab CI-style 'if' expressions.

mlflow_dataset.description: Optional: record each completed run as an entry in a persistent MLflow evaluation dataset (in the same PostgreSQL tracking store used by mlflow-eval), in addition to or instead of the JSON report file.

enabled.description: Whether to write a record to the MLflow dataset for each completed run.

name.description: MLflow evaluation dataset name. Defaults to 'fluxnova-<process_key>'.

tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking URI. Defaults to the PostgreSQL store at postgresql://mlflow:mlflow@localhost:5432/mlflow (see local-dev/postgres-up.sh).

also_write_json_report.description: Whether to also write the usual JSON agent-history report file. Set false to write only to the MLflow dataset.

experiment_name.description: MLflow experiment name to target. Defaults to 'fluxnova-<process_key>'. Set to easily point runs/records at a different experiment without changing any other config.

ExpectedToolRule.description: A single tool-expectation rule. 'tool' is always required; 'if' makes the rule conditional.

tool.description: Display name of the expected tool. Must match a value in available_tools.

if.description: Optional condition — '$variableName == value' or '$variableName != value'. Resolved against inputVariables from the agent-history report.
